values.note: RV site $40 a night for up to 4 people, plus $5 a night for bathhouse use; $240 a week (7th night free, +$30 for the bathhouse); $5 per extra person a night; monthly by phone. Primitive tent sites $25. Read on the operator's site 2026-10-21.

fees.source: https://outpostresort.com/accommodations/ (RV Site Rates: '$40.00 per night up to 4 persons. Add $5.00 per night for bathhouse'; '$240.00 per week for up to 4 persons'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://outpostresort.com/accommodations/ ('Each RV site has full hookups with 30 or 50 amp service.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Reservations for overnight accommodations ... are required' and 'are made by phone only' (352-236-4606; the office is closed Tuesdays but returns messages, and sites are still available on Tuesdays). Check in at the Outpost building before going to the site. RV cancellations: 1 week's notice ($50 fee after), 30 days for holidays ($100).

booking.source: https://outpostresort.com/ ('Reservations for overnight accommodations and river trips are required') + https://outpostresort.com/policies/ ('Reservations are made by phone only.'; 'Holidays are a 2 night minimum stay'; 'Closed on Tuesdays - Cabins, tent, and RV sites are available on Tuesdays'), read 2026-10-21

note: On the Ocklawaha River at Fort McCoy; large open RV area, picnic table and fire ring at each site. Canoe/kayak launches and fishing docks inside the campground; the outpost also rents cabins and tent sites and runs paddle trips. Coord from RV Life (not independently re-pinned).
